title: Valeo Health launches UNLOCK longevity programme in UAE to advance preventive healthcare
summary: The programme combines comprehensive blood testing, medical interpretation and personalised recommendations to give members a broader understanding of their health.
thbAction: Pitch THB's diagnostics CRM to help labs manage doctor outreach, collection-center expansion, and B2B referral relationships while improving conversion and retention.
contentHtml:
UAE—Valeo Health has launched UNLOCK, a doctor-led health programme in the UAE, to help individuals assess their health, identify potential risks and make informed decisions about long-term wellbeing.

The programme combines comprehensive blood testing, medical interpretation and personalised recommendations to give members a broader understanding of their health.

It examines more than 70 biomarkers covering metabolic and hormonal function, cardiovascular health, liver function and inflammation.

Unlike conventional health assessments that present test results individually, UNLOCK places the findings within a wider clinical context.

Physicians help members understand their results, identify areas that may require attention and develop practical strategies to improve their health.

Longitudinal health monitoring

The programme follows a continuous assessment model.

Members begin by establishing a personal health baseline through comprehensive testing, which physicians use to develop an individual care plan.

Subsequent assessments allow them to track changes and evaluate their progress over time.

UNLOCK also includes dedicated longevity panels for men and women, recognising biological differences in health profiles.

Based on the findings, Valeo Health physicians provide recommendations covering nutrition, physical activity, sleep and recovery.

Commenting on the launch, Manisha at Valeo Health said understanding individual health profiles should form the basis of informed decisions about future health.

She noted that UNLOCK brings together medical information, clinical expertise and ongoing guidance to help individuals move beyond one-time health assessments and take a more proactive approach to longevity.

Dr Rayan Mohammed, Functional Medicine Practitioner at Valeo Health, highlighted the importance of monitoring health patterns over time.

“One set of results gives us an understanding of someone’s health at a particular point in time, but it is the patterns we observe over time that can provide additional clinical context,” he said.

He explained that combining comprehensive testing with medical interpretation and regular reassessment could help individuals make informed decisions and better understand changes in their health.

Growing demand for preventive healthcare

The launch comes as the UAE healthcare sector places greater emphasis on preventive medicine, personalised healthcare and longevity.

This shift is creating opportunities for providers to expand beyond episodic consultations and introduce services that support continuous health monitoring.

For healthcare providers, programmes built around biomarker testing and longitudinal data also create opportunities to strengthen patient engagement and develop more personalised care pathways.

However, their clinical value depends on appropriate medical interpretation, evidence-based interventions and clear communication about what individual biomarkers can and cannot reveal.

Through UNLOCK, Valeo Health is expanding its preventive healthcare offering by combining laboratory testing, physician-led assessments and ongoing health monitoring.

The programme targets individuals seeking a clearer understanding of their health status, potential risk factors and areas that may require further medical attention.
